name: Peec AI
description: Monitor and analyze your brand's visibility across AI search engines. Track your visibility, sentiment, and share of voice and compare to competitors.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Peec AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Peec AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.peec.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Peec AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Peec AI provides these MCP tools: list_projects, list_brands, list_prompts, list_topics, list_tags, get_brand_report, get_domain_report, and get_url_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Peec AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Peec AI in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Peec AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Peec AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Peec AI is developed by Peec AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
